faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for the CNLU Patna Counsellor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by Chanakya National Law University, Patna (CNLU Patna) for filling up contractual positions in the state of Bihar.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under the CNLU Patna Counsellor notification?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the position of Counsellor under advertisement number 51/2026-27(Appt.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form for CNLU Patna Counsellor?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their filled applications online on or before 10-10-2026 through the designated Google Form link provided by the university.

faq.question: Q4. What educational qualification is required for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess an MA or M. Phil. in Psychology, or an M. Phil. in Medical & Social Psychology from an institution recognized by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee required to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for submitting the application form for the Counsellor position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the CNLU Patna Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Counsellor position is negotiable as per the university guidelines and candidate's qualifications or experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for CNLU Patna Counsellor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted exclusively through online mode by uploading scanned application forms using the official Google Form link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the CNLU Patna Counsellor vacancy?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of candidates followed by a personal interview conducted by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q9. Is prior experience mandatory for applying to the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: While basic qualifications are mandatory, having two years of clinical, research, or teaching experience from a recognized institution is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates access the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the official notification details, application link, and other important resources directly through the designated sections of this article.
